units.source_text: 最后我折回大书院后面，捡起那个裹着不易燃物的包袱，直奔金阁东头的池畔走去。

en.t: At last I turned back behind the Great Study, picked up the bundle wrapped in nonflammable material, and hurried straight toward the pond bank at the eastern end of the Golden Pavilion.

units.source_text: 那就是眼前可以望及池心的泊舟石的地方。

en.t: That was the spot by the mooring stone, from which one could look out over the center of the pond just ahead.

units.source_text: 那里的几株松树的树阴，他强可以避雨。

en.t: In the shade of the few pine trees there, he could just barely take shelter from the rain.
